system.description:
Demon's Claw. Attack Action: make a CR 1 Strange Check. On a success, deal 2 Soul damage to all enemies within Near Range in front of you. It deals 1 Soul damage to you and ticks the Doom Clock 3 minutes.

Unholy (Flaw). Minor Disadvantage while on holy ground. You have a Weakness to Holy weapons and abilities.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.91
